verified_facts.text: The resort is set in Mexico's coastal rainforest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Woven into Mexico’s awe-inspiring coastal rainforest, One&Only Mandarina offers unparalleled seclusion

verified_facts.text: The Riviera Nayarit resort has emerald cliffs, palm-fringed sands, lagoons and estuaries, on an unspoiled stretch of coast with a swimmable beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Emerald cliffs meet palm-fringed sands, lagoons and estuaries at our tropical Riviera Nayarit resort, nestled on an unspoiled slice of coast with a swimmable beach.

verified_facts.text: The resort is about an hour from Puerto Vallarta International Airport by luxury SUV or Sprinter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Travel to the resort by luxury SUV or Sprinter in about an hour.

verified_facts.text: The Mexican-inspired design showcases artisanal makers and local creators.
verified_facts.excerpt: One&Only Mandarina’s Mexican-inspired design showcases artisanal makers and local creators, with interiors drawing on vibrant visual influences and rich cultural traditions.

verified_facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly, offering pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies for dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vacation with your furry family members at our pet-friendly resort where we can cater to your canine with pet-sitting, dog walking and special pet supplies.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed in the Treehouses.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not allow pets in our Treehouses

verified_facts.text: The resort does not accept cash; bills are settled by credit card.
verified_facts.excerpt: One&Only Mandarina does not accept cash payments.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi service is available throughout the resort.

verified_facts.text: High season in Riviera Nayarit runs from October to April, while July and August are hotter and more humid.
verified_facts.excerpt: High season is from October to April while July and August are hotter with higher humidity.

verified_facts.text: Each free-standing villa and treehouse has its own private plunge pool with views of the jungle canopy or the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: has its own private plunge pool and comes with expansive views of the jungle canopy or the azure Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: Rooms have beds draped in Mexican textiles and ceramic mugs made by artisans in Oaxaca.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooms show off beds draped in Mexican textiles and ceramic mugs made by artisans in Oaxaca

verified_facts.text: The spa's treatment rooms are built within a natural volcanic rock garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: treatment rooms are built within a natural volcanic rock garden

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments are inspired by Indigenous and pre-Hispanic cultures and include mud bath treatments and sessions in an on-site temazcal sweat lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments are inspired by Indigenous and pre-Hispanic cultures, and go beyond typical massage offerings to include mud bath treatments and sessions in the on-site temazcal

verified_facts.text: Every booking comes with a designated butler for all requests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every booking comes with a designated butler that acts as a go-to for all requests.

verified_facts.text: The kids club area has tree houses connected by suspended bridges, slides, climbing walls and paved trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: the area is home to a series of tree houses connected by suspended bridges, slides, climbing walls, and paved trails

verified_facts.text: Rock carvings by the local Cora and Huichol cultures are present on the property and have been preserved.
verified_facts.excerpt: many rock carvings by the local Cora and Huichol cultures are present on the property and have been preserved

verified_facts.text: The resort is within easy driving distance of the beach towns of Sayulita and San Pancho.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property is situated within easy driving distance of the relaxed beach towns of Sayulita and San Pancho.

verified_facts.text: The grounds have hiking trails past the property's lagoons and estuaries.
verified_facts.excerpt: myriad hiking trails past the property’s lagoons and estuaries

verified_facts.text: Carao by Enrique Olvera is a coastal-inspired restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the coastal-inspired restaurant Carao by Enrique Olvera

verified_facts.text: Alma is an open-air, garden-to-plate restaurant with two wood-fired ovens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alma, an open-air, garden-to-plate restaurant
